documentation: A generated demo (#212): a fictional manufacturer moving the local data of 160 sites into one central data lake per region, with a few planning problems seeded on purpose. Regenerate it with `npm run demo:generate`; never edit it by hand.

sites.notes: HR records fall under Swiss data protection law; legal review of the move is open.

exceptions.rationale: Reporting reads the lake a week before the first mock load.
Quality records stay readable on site until the product audit closes.

sites.notes: Reads its stock data from Wien office 2, which must migrate first.
Cutover set for 31 March at the site’s request, before the Q1 close was checked.
Mock load 1 found duplicate supplier records; they are cleansed before mock load 2.

exceptions.rationale: The works council keeps its share on site until its own move.
